Supreme Court Clears Manmohan Singh in Coal Scam Case

The Supreme Court has accepted the Central Bureau of Investigation's (CBI) closure report, thereby clearing former Prime Minister Manmohan Singh in a coal block allocation case. The case, which dates back 11 years, involved allegations of irregularities in the allocation of coal blocks. The CBI had previously decided to close the case, a decision now upheld by the apex court.
